engine: sfizz 1.2.3 official Windows x64 release; native C API; quality 10, freewheeling, 512 voices, stereo 44100Hz.

policy.velocity: 16 equal MIDI bins, within-layer RMS based gain as in bitKlavier, +4dB extended range; no crossfade of different recorded attacks
policy.pitch: nearest recorded root +/-1 semitone; original roots not retuned
policy.sustain: CC64 >=64; native SFZ sustain. Intermediate sensor values delivered but no calibrated physical half-pedal model.
policy.soft: CC67 continuous volume reduction up to 3dB, not an actual una-corda recording.
policy.release: 30ms sampler release for damped keys; original resonance samples -20dB, 4.34294dB/s elapsed-time attenuation.
policy.hammer: Original key-return samples per key, -40dB, release_key; velocity follows the sampler trigger.
policy.pedal_noise: Recorded D1/U1 samples -20dB at alternating full-travel endpoints (>=115 / <=10), independent of the >=64 damper threshold; extra CC20/21 are internal cues, original MIDI unmodified.
policy.upper_keys: F#6 and above play recorded decay to its end; no artificial loop.
policy.envelope: 3ms onset envelope; sampler reproduction, not untouched standalone WAV or a new acoustic performance.
